buildings.name: Orbital command shuttle · Level 1
buildings.description: Upright command shuttle: permanent general-purpose crew, fusion electricity, storage, one charging berth and two large weapon banks. Manufactures only workers. Specialist factories supply all materials, weapons and vehicles. Higher levels add wings around the same shuttle.

buildings.name: Charging station
buildings.description: One physical charging berth with one assigned attendant. A full session occupies ten calendar minutes; the attendant also uses the berth. Power, travel and queues reduce the ideal 144 daily sessions.

balance_status: Provisional costs, durations, staffing, capacities and health. Confirmed tier geometry and hardpoint constraints are validated separately. Upgrade bills are incremental and stored on the source level. prototype-9.2 adds progression gates: AI chip works, tank factory and battery works need tier-2 products beyond the landing kit; fusion works, mech factory and plasma towers need locally made AI chips; every level-3 upgrade needs AI chips and the core needs fusion reactors.
capacity_note: Provisional closed storage in litres. Vehicle factories and cores hold the full largest permitted chassis plus a legal full weapon loadout, ammunition and local operating buffers; capacity adds no starting materials. Advanced assembly still needs enough charged batteries on the shared colony grid.
quantity_note: Provisional v0.9 physical construction bills in native cargo units. Core level 1 is a preinstalled landed shuttle: its 20 kg bill is deployment consumables, not its unmodeled hull/reactor mass. Level 2/3 costs include expansion and installed upgrade equipment. Tower costs include equipped modules; replacements discard old modules without refund.
